what: Linear proxy for committed witness bits at the LDE (blowup 2), excluding fixed trees, as used in vectors/reports/rv64-ethereum-20261101/committed-work-comparison-v1.json. bits = 62 * (cpu_cells_per_instruction*instructions + keccak_cells_per_call*keccak_f_calls + secp_cells_per_call*(secp_add_calls+secp_double_calls)) * (1 + composition_fraction).

calibration_run.schema: Word16 core schema 7 (LS32), 25 CPU + 5 truth proofs

caveats: Frozen at prover schema 7 so the guest score does not move when the prover changes; recalibrate only by explicit ledger epoch.
Linear in instruction count: ignores instruction mix (loads/stores vs ALU), fact de-duplication and power-of-two padding of truth proofs.
Promotion requires the exact tier (Word16 plan/prove cost.json), not this proxy.
candidate_services_note: Estimated cells per call and per byte for execution-only candidate services. Each entry must cite its derivation (analogous AIR widths, rows per call, bridge columns). Entries are estimates until a qualified AIR exists; the exact tier replaces them.

sha256_compress.status: MEASURED on a complete-block Word16 proof of block 24,628,607 with the admitted evmone v3 guest (client_evmone build.py --profile v3; 9 CPU + 6 truth proofs, freshly verified with `verify`); cells are exact padded MAIN+INTERACTION from cost.json/roster.json, fixed columns excluded
sha256_compress.derivation: Truth log12 (2,901 calls): MAIN 30,347,264 + INTER 32,768 = 30,380,032 cells (cost.json truth); Wire35 bridge rows (3 per call, MAIN 134 + INTER 244) over the 9 CPU proofs: 6,217,344 cells (roster.json sha256_bridge, 8,703 active rows); (30,380,032 + 6,217,344) / 2,901 = 12,615.4. Earlier 4-shard Rust-guest prefix measurement: 12,150.9 (2,771 calls). Nominal unpadded 8,551. Excludes the ECALL's CPU row (costed per instruction) and shared U16/U8 table multiplicities. design/riscv-proving-stack/rv64-sha256-service.md, rv64-services-v3-integration.md.

arith256_mod.derivation: Truth log9 (319 calls, padded to 512 rows): MAIN 205,312 + INTER 249,856 = 455,168 cells; Word16 bridge rows (5 per call, MAIN 134 + INTER 244) over the CPU proofs: 967,680 cells (roster.json arith256_mod_bridge, 1,595 active rows); (455,168 + 967,680) / 319 = 4,460.3. Layout tier for comparison: 2,779 unpadded x 1/ln 2 = 4,009.3. design/riscv-proving-stack/rv64-arith256-service.md.

memcpy.derivation: desc rows (one per call, memcpy and memset share the component): 5,734,400 cells / 37,168 calls = 154.3 per call; copy rows: 50,462,720 cells / 3,330,392 copied bytes (416,299 words) = 15.152 per byte. memcpy_unaligned.status: LAYOUT TIER from the proven component widths of the bulk-extension services fixture (services/bulk_ext_fixture.zig, real CPU STARKs, fresh receiver; test-riscv64-word16-bulk-services); not yet measured on a complete-block proof (desc share is the complete-block measurement of memcpy)

keccak_sponge.status: MEASURED geometry of the complete block 26,235,156 with the admitted evmone v3 guest routing Keccak-256 inputs > 64 bytes to the sponge (client_evmone build.py --profile v3 --v3-set sha,arith,mem,keccak; rv64-ethereum-proof nativeprepare: 5 packets, completed; rv64-word16-ethereum plan: 5 CPU shards, Keccak truth spans log18 + log16). Exact padded MAIN+INTERACTION cells = column widths x 2^log of the planned components (the same computation cost.json performs); fixed columns excluded. Confirmed by a produced proof: 1-packet prefix of the same block (rv64-word16-ethereum produce ... 1; fresh verify-prefix accepted), whose cost.json/roster.json report sponge_call log 12 (694+380 columns, 2,943 active rows, 4,399,104 cells = 1,494.7/call) and sponge_perm log 14 (973+688, 13,685 active rows, 27,213,824 cells = 1,988.6/permutation), matching the plan geometry.
keccak_sponge.derivation: 4,731 sponge calls, 19,562 permutations (2,499,833 bytes). call rows: logs 12/5/5/11 over the four sponge shards = 6,208 rows x (MAIN 694 + INTER 380) = 6,667,392 cells / 4,731 calls = 1,409.3 per call (nominal 1,074). perm rows: logs 14/5/7/13 = 24,736 rows x (973 + 688) = 41,086,496 / 19,562 = 2,100.3 per permutation (nominal 1,661). Each permutation also takes one Keccak-f truth ID: costed at the frozen keccak_cells_per_call (72,159.3, same truth AIR); this block's own truth measured 70,533.8 per ID (2^18 + 2^16 rows x 4,519 / 20,994 IDs). cells_per_permutation = 2,100.3 + 72,159.3. The per-call Word16 Keccak-f bridge rows that sponge permutations no longer need stay inside the frozen CPU coefficient. design/riscv-proving-stack/rv64-keccak-sponge-service.md section 6. Throughput-v1 Keccak-f truth (v3 default, 2026-11-02): each permutation's truth ID costed at keccak_cells_per_call_v3 = 41,072.0 instead of 72,159.3, so cells_per_permutation = 2,100.3 + 41,072.0 (was 74259.6).

admitted_services_note: Cells per call and per byte for ADMITTED ethereum_services_v3 services, measured on whole-block proofs (never estimates); every entry states its status and derivation. bench.py ADMITTED_REPORT_FIELDS maps each entry to the execution-report fields it is applied to (sha256_calls, arith256_mod_calls, bulk_{memcpy,memset}_{calls,bytes}).
keccak_cells_per_call_v3_note: ethereum_services_v3 only (bench.py keccak_coefficient); v2 and baseline rows keep keccak_cells_per_call. Throughput-v1 Keccak-f truth (rv64/air/delegations/keccak batch_policy throughput_v1: RV32 2^21 five-output chi and 2^16 three-position xor5 tables, MAIN 1923 unchanged, INTERACTION 2596 -> 608). Same truth roster geometry as the frozen compact coefficient (32,835 calls in two log18 truth proofs, 72,159.27 = (2 x 2^18 x 4,519 + 2 x 5 x (2^13 + 2^10)) / 32,835): (2 x 2^18 x (1,923 + 608) + 2 x 5 x (2^21 + 2^16)) / 32,835 = 41,072.0 cells/call (-43.1%). Column widths x 2^log are the cost.json computation (setup.logs); widths confirmed by the services sponge fixture proof with a fresh receiver (test-riscv64-word16-sponge-services, truth log7: compact 624,512 vs throughput 11,137,408 cells, i.e. the 2^21 table dominates small truths, hence the planner selects throughput only for truth log >= 13 where it commits fewer cells). Fixed columns (7 x 2^21 chi table) excluded as for every coefficient.
